text.en: Clients warmly praise instructors like Matt for structured guidance, patient coaching, and positive reinforcement during training sessions. However, severe criticism arose over an incident where a dog went missing from day camp, with reviewers citing a lack of urgency and empathy.

Dog parents report impressive progress in leash manners, reduced reactivity, and curbs on puppy biting after multi-week board-and-train courses. Conversely, one client noted that behavioral improvements quickly reverted without clear post-program support and guidance.

title.en: Enriching training contrasted by safety concerns

text.en: Many owners describe positive transformations and confident dogs returning happily from camp and training routines. At the same time, a highly critical review involving a lost pet during day camp raised grave concerns regarding animal safety and emergency protocols.

q.en: What training methods are utilized at this facility?

a.en: Trainers emphasize positive reinforcement methods, working to reduce reactivity and build confidence through structured board-and-train courses.

q.en: Do trainers provide guidance for continuing training at home?

a.en: Yes, clients note that trainers coach owners on maintaining consistency, although some reviewers felt post-training instructions could be more detailed.

q.en: Does the facility offer pick-up and drop-off transport?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that convenient pick-up and drop-off transport services are available for dogs participating in boarding and training.
